ros.expect: Sleeper's week-w projection alone beats season PPG at every week; the best blend puts most weight on the projection and xFP; the 50/50 prior+PPG rule is 5-10% worse in MAE than the best blend.
ros.curve_note: prior/ROS rank -> PPG of the k-th best player at the position in the PREVIOUS season (>= 8 games)

spread.expect: Coverage: the IQR-based table gives about 50% at the 50% interval but well under 90% at the 90% interval (heavy right tail). Player trait: split-half correlation of the residual-SD ratio 0.1-0.3, season to season under 0.2; the NLL-best shrinkage is 20+ games, so SD_SHRINK = 6 is too light.

trait.units: player-seasons with mean projection >= 5; residual RMS in table units

dst.expect: About -0.2 to -0.3 D/ST points per point of opponent implied total; quality adds little; the 24/19 rule gains about 1.5-2 points per move but fires rarely; a gap rule (ours minus FA >= 4-5) does as well per move and fires more often.

k.expect: About +0.15 to +0.25 K points per point of own implied total; dome +0.3-0.5; wind above 15 mph costs about 1 point; a 4-point gap is worth about 0.6-1.0 points per move, close to the noise floor.

flags.expect: BUY players outscore points-rank peers by about +1 PPG over the next four weeks (CI touching 0 to +2); SELL players underperform by about -1; the effect grows with the gap and the gap of 8 is in the flat part.
flags.outcome: PPG over weeks w to w+3, players with 2+ games in that window
